name: dbcanvas
description: DBCanvas - SQL database inspector for AI IDEs
author: XMN

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dbcanvas/core && npm run build -w @dbcanvas/mcp-server && npm run build:full -w @dbcanvas/desktop && npm run build -w @dbcanvas/platform
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @dbcanvas/core && npm run build -w @dbcanvas/mcp-server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @dbcanvas/core && npm run build:full -w @dbcanvas/desktop
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @dbcanvas/desktop
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @dbcanvas/core && npm run clean -w @dbcanvas/mcp-server && npm run clean -w @dbcanvas/desktop
